images.actual_source_analysis: One adult woman with dark brown hair in a loose bun stands full-length in a bright glass conservatory. She wears a rust knit cardigan over a cream top, cream wide-leg trousers and beige loafers. Her left-side hand rests on the extended handle of one olive hard-shell rolling suitcase at image left, while her other hand is in a trouser pocket. Broad green leaves and terracotta pots stand behind her on the left; grid windows and a brick floor recede at right.
